text:
Ava L: Heads-up — onboarding quickstart links to /guides/runtime#kv-cache now 404s after yesterday's sidebar refactor. getting a support ticket about it. anyone own that fragment?
Ken M: i moved a couple of headings during the tidy, might be related. tagging @Priya who owns runtime content.
Priya: i didn't intentionally rename anchors but i did compress a subheading. can you paste the failing URL?
Ava L: the quickstart has https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/runtime#kv-cache but the page now uses #kv-cache-tuning.
infra-bot: deploy log: sidebar-update-2026-03-18 completed — moved /guides/runtime sections.
Priya: easy enough — either restore the old anchor as an HTML alias or update quickstart. i'd prefer alias so external links don't break.
Ken M: agreed, alias + short changelog line. low-risk.
Ava L: created a tiny PR to reintroduce the legacy anchor and fix the quickstart link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12801 — adds <!-- legacy-anchor: kv-cache --> and updates quickstart. PTAL.
Ken M: reviewing now. quick nit: need a blank line before the HTML comment to keep md linter happy.
Priya: once Ken approves i can merge after CI. also propose we add a CI spotcheck that fetches internal anchors during the doc build. small bash snippet idea: 
```
# docs dev check: resolve internal anchors
python -c "import sys,requests,re; import markdownify as m; urls=['https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/runtime#kv-cache'];
for u in urls: r=requests.get(u.split('#')[0]);
if r.status_code!=200 or ('#'+u.split('#')[1]) not in r.text: print('MISSING ANCHOR',u)"
```
docs-bot: reminder: please add labels `docs` and `runbook-owner` on PRs that touch onboarding guides.
Ava L: updated PR with the blank line fix. added changelog note: "Preserve legacy runtime anchor to avoid breaking quickstart links."
Ken M: approved.
Priya: CI green, merging. i'll drop the PR link into support ticket INC-5902 so the customer sees the resolution.
Ava L: thanks — will follow up with a tiny owners spreadsheet entry under "nav churn" so we can track frequency.
Ken M: nice quick win.
Priya: lunch later? :pizza:
